query.description: The text to search for, embedded with the configured embedding model. A sentence or a question works better than a few keywords, because the index stores whole passages.

scope.description: Which corpus to search: earlier conversations and the current one (`transcript`), the agent's memory files (`memory`), or both. Defaults to `both`.

limit.description: How many passages to return, best score first. Defaults to 5; at most 20.
